400 error when the prompt exceeds the model's maximum context length

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    try {
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Very long prompt that exceeds the context window...\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chat(request)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        System.err.println("${error::class.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }
}
```
